name: Walkout Plank
instructions: From standing, fold forward and walk your hands out to a plank.
Hold the plank for 2-3 seconds with a tight, straight body.
Walk the hands back in and stand up.
Repeat for reps. Combines a hamstring stretch with core work.
longevityNotes: A stable trunk protects the spine through every decade. Train the core for endurance and control rather than chasing burn.
overview: A beginner just your bodyweight core exercise for the abs. Walkout Plank builds the trunk stability that underpins safe movement as you age.
